errors.text_span: während die EU27-Quote bei etwa 68 % liegt
errors.evidence: The bar for EU27 is clearly at the 70% line, same as Polen and USA. The reference description also states 70%. The machine's value of 68% is incorrect.
The bar for the USA is clearly at the 70% line, same as Polen and EU27. The reference description also states 70%. The machine's value of 69% is incorrect.

The bar for Vereinigtes Königreich (United Kingdom) is just below the 70% line, at approximately 69%, which is also the value given in the reference description. The machine's value of 66% is significantly too low.

The bar for Italien (Italy) is visually lower than the bar for the Vereinigtes Königreich (United Kingdom). The machine description states the UK is at 66% and Italy is at 67%, incorrectly reversing their order. The reference value for Italy is 66%.
